text:
𝗦𝗪𝗘𝗘𝗣 𝗗𝗢𝗡𝗘! 🇮🇳

India Women beat Zimbabwe by 8 wkts in Vadodara to win the ODI series 3-0.

Vaishnavi 5/39, then Shafali 51* (26) and Rawal 59* chased 132 in 17 overs 🔥

#Cricket #WomensCricket

facebook.caption:
𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮 𝗪𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗻 𝗻𝗲 𝗸𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝟯-𝟬 𝗸𝗮 𝘀𝘄𝗲𝗲𝗽! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 Vadodara ke 3rd ODI mein Zimbabwe 131 pe all out
👉 Vaishnavi Sharma ke 5/39, Player of the Match
👉 Shafali Verma 51* (26 balls) aur Pratika Rawal 59*
👉 India ne 133/2 banaye sirf 17 over mein

Is series ki sabse badi star kaun? Comment karo 👇
